visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long, straight brown hair and dark-tinted sunglasses smiles confidently toward the camera, her facial expressions showing happiness. She is wearing a black bikini top. Behind her, a coastal beach club with white lounge chairs and umbrellas sits against rocky cliffs under bright natural daylight. (2) The camera transitions to a high-angle shot overlooking a vibrant blue sea. While no people are visible in close-up, distant swimmers can be seen. A small white boat moves slowly across the water. The coastline features lush green trees and a lower patio area with white umbrellas and sunbathers in the distance under bright sunlight. (3) A close-up shot focuses on a pair of hands with yellow nail polish holding a white tube of sunscreen with a gold cap. The product's packaging is clean and minimalist. The background shows the character's fair-skinned legs resting on a pink and white striped towel on a lounge chair in an outdoor setting. (4) A pair of pale legs and feet with yellow-painted toenails are shown dangling over the edge of a crystal-clear blue swimming pool. The character's face is not visible, only the lower limbs. The water ripples gently, reflecting the bright sky. The pool edge is made of light-colored stone with soft shadows. (5) A hand with manicured nails holding a white and gold spray bottle appears, spraying a fine mist onto a fair-skinned forearm. The person then uses their other hand to rub the product into the skin, which takes on a smooth, glowing appearance. The background shifts to an indoor setting with a wooden chair. (6) A demonstration of the spray bottle shows a fine, consistent white mist being released from the nozzle against a background of a large floor-to-ceiling window and a grey tiled floor. The bright natural light from outside casts long, sharp shadows of the window frame across the indoor floor surface. (7) A final close-up shot displays the white sunscreen spray bottle held upright in a hand. The label 'W.STYLE' is clearly visible on the packaging. The hand is adorned with a gold bracelet and features nails with a decorative small black heart, set against a blurred indoor room background.
